text: I always order from this location for a couple of reasons. 1. They have great customer services and 2. They often have free delivery via DoorDash on their website. Their website is easier to navigate than the actual DoorDash app which I find so weird. Highly recommend if you are looking for a reliable Wing Stop that won't mess up your order constantly.
I give Olive Garden 5 stars because the bread is so good and the appetizers are amazing

Great pizza! Not quite NY style but a thinner chewy crust. Sauce was perfectly balanced. My kids insisted we order pizza and chicken wings from there twice during our stay. 

Best to call in your order. Too many people make the mistake of walking in to order and realizing the front space is quite small.

love love love this place!  very good food. 
my favorite cheese cake is reese's peanut butter chocolate cake cheesecake!!
First time here, very good food and excellent service. Our waiter was very friendly and attentive. Great job with new restrictions! Will definitely be back !
Loved this! The whole vibe was fun. We were able to walk right in and get a table for 3, but we were there over a holiday weekend. The grilled corn off the cob was phenomenal, and we loved the guac!

Food, location, bartenders and wait staff are all excellent. 

Consider long wait times on the weekend. Hostess stand is sometimes chaotic.

I heard rave reviews and we finally tried this place on Hampton. We got two pretzel meat dogs, a regular standard pretzel, and cinnamon glaze softie. Our wrapped meat dogs were disappointing! The two just didn't seem to go together, in a way? It seemed to be that it had been cooked hours before (we went at the beginning dinner). The pretzel was not as soft and fluffy around the meat but thin and hard. Our jaws had to work extra to get a bite. The customer service was okay. It was hard to communicate on the phone and they assumed I knew about the place. I would recommend not making assumptions that everyone knows the language on the Pretzel Boys food. It would have helped to not have radio silence when I'm trying to figure out the menu and live up to explaining "the twisted experience". We would go again, but would consider only regular pretzels.
I love this place.  The food is delicious, even if a bit overpriced.  I will return.
Great place with good service!! Plenty of seating, inside to watch a game or out on the patio. The food was very good with many options.

i thought i liked spicy, but the lovely waitress told me to only do half the spice in my ramen because it was REALLY spicy...well she wasn't wrong! it came out JUST RIGHT and i'm so happy she gave me the heads up or else i probably wouldn't have been able to enjoy it! the edamame was cold which was a first for me, still delicious just a first. i HIGHLY recommend!

So... My boyfriend and I decided to come to The Social tonight for some casual cosmopolitan dinner. We called ahead and got on the wait. We showed up right on time and were taken to our table immediately. We were greeted and served by a perfectly lovely young lady named Holly. She had the perfect amount of professionalism and more importantly... FUN atmosphere excitement. She made our evening complete... Along with the amazing Dueling Pianos evening!!!! SO much fun!!!! Thank you Holly...  Love you... Michael and Carl

We went there for dinner last night because they have the best fried zucchini. We ordered a large pizza, fried zucchini, mozzarella sticks and a pitcher of beer. The pizza was going to take an hour which is fine because it was Friday evening. Totally understandable. The beer glasses were so dirty! I had to ask for clean ones and all the "clean glasses" he kept pulling out of their cooler were dirty. Anyways when the mozzarella sticks and zucchini came out we noticed they changed the zucchini. And not for the better. Pizza was not the best we ever had. Food was overall ok but probably won't be going back there.

This is a cute local place with good coffee and amazing gourmet biscuits. The chicken salad biscuit lunch didn't blow me away, but it was still good as far as chicken salad goes. The biscuit was soft, buttery, and completely melted in my mouth.  I loved the gourmet biscuit and desperately wished they had their flavors of the day, but by the time I got there they were sold out for the day. But the blueberry crisp biscuit? Maaaaaann. Sweet, without being too sweet, buttery, soft, and bursting with berries. Coffee was good - the Roxanne drip coffee had so much flavor to it that I barely needed any cream. The atmosphere was adorable and felt homey without being too overwhelming. The staff were kind and kept the place clean.
this place has the best beer ever I love the chili porter!!!!'I can't believe it's closed. Best fries best brussel sprouts omg. I truly love this place!
The quality here has really deteriorated over the years. Food is reheated and not fresh, and it's obvious. Dessert was average if at all. The only reason they even deserve any stars is the service.

Didn't know what to expect at first. We were seated in a large, somewhat loud room at a picnic table with a view of the ocean. The windows were so foggy that we could hardly take advantage of the ocean view. Server was decent but the food was excellent! We had the crab, coconut shrimp and mussels. Kids loved it, we left full and happy.

Was unable to complete my order online through their website. After trying to order a salad, soup and meatballs unsuccessfully for 15 minutes, I called the restaurant to place the order by phone. The first time someone picked up they mumbled something and hung up the phone. I called back and a woman answered and I said, "I'd like to place an order for delivery- I was just on your website for 15 min and I can't get it to go thru." She says she can't take my order over the phone, to which I respond, "Fine then I'll go on Yelp and describe my experience in a bad review." 

She then sounded like she was about to take the order, but went on to describe 3rd party websites I've never heard of that I should use to order my food...when I'm talking to someone who could have taken my order as a courtesy for my inconvenience.

So, I tell her that's fine, I'm just going to write a Yelp review instead and she said ok and hung up on me. People try to order food because they are hungry, and people order salads because they're trying to be healthy. Now, I'm just going on the Burger King app because it works. I'm so disappointed, because Sauce has great food, but tonight a very rude staff female. 

*For management: this took place at 6:25pm on 2/12/21- so you might want to figure out who on your team is answering the phone and ruining your reputation, when she knew her behavior would be shared publicly. Thank you.

I come to this location frequently and this location is the best one I've ever been to. The food is always hot and fresh. The employees at the drive thru are always nice as well. Awesome location and great food! Easily a 5 star from me!!

Avoid.

Gave server a food allergy explanation card when I ordered breakfast. The card lists dairy generally and provides numerous examples. Was assured by server that the chef would not include any ingredients that would trigger my food allergy.   Shortly after my meal I began suffering symptoms associated with my food allergy. I called the restaurant. I was promised a return call. I appreciate that they are busy and I'm just someone with a complaint - however it's almost 3 weeks. No call.  

It's clear in my opinion they could care less about poisoning customers 

Eat there at your own risk.
Stopped for lunch on a cold day,  had a hot bowl of tomato soup that was memorable. Really good burger with fries, Food was great, excellent service. All COVID rules followed, plenty of space.
Got love the edge. 3 inches of no cheese and sausage. Just a whip of sauce order 18in got a 14in.

The most "enh" Mexican place I've been. Senor Salsa is the epitome of "it's okay". The burritos and enchiladas aren't bad.  The good news is that the food is pretty cheap: you can get a decently-sized meal for around $10.  The wait staff is friendly and attentive.  There's a lot of seating but, strangely, not nearly as much parking.  Overall, Senor Salsa is a perfectly fine place for Mexican food.

Absolute best cheesesteaks I've ever had. It's all about the bread and they have the freshest ever. Really enjoyed the mussels, and a couple of their pasta's as well. My friend is vegan and said she's even able to enjoy their pastas too. I also want to personally say thank you for them accommodating to my husbands allergy to tomato. We asked for a pizza made with Alfredo sauce (SO GOOD) as it isn't on the menu- and they did it no questions asked. We were grateful and will be customers for life. Thank you so much to the only place we get delivery from.

Usually EATS has great service and cold beer, unfortunately not yesterday. I ordered a bud light and noticed there was zero carbonation. Instead of asking the waitress to take it back, I just drank it not wanting to make a big deal of it. When she brought me another one (it was two for one) I told her that the beer was flat. Instead of asking me if I wanted a different beer, she just set it down and walked away. Terrible service. The place also has a hint of sewage smell.
We ordered the fried chicken platter & hot honey chicken sandwich and they were both amazing!!! Best fried chicken!! Clean establishment & friendly wait staff

First time in and without knowing really what I was getting, I must say, with the selection that was left on the board- it all looks delicious.. the flying pig was just that, however this and my beef asada came a bit cold... and the beef was a bit bland. But I'm from New Orleans where even white rice has flavor

Excellent food and service. We were traveling and wanted great Chinese food and this did not disappoint. Found reviews on Yelp that we based our choice on and we are glad we found this place. The only problem was the GPS tried to get us to go across the street. It is in the strip mall where Hobby Lobby is located.

Dinner was good but they had way to much going on. Music on. Tv sound on and inside noise was super loud too!! We got there was told didn't need reservations but then we got there and the balcony was full after they just sat a party of 6 ladies who came in after us....

I'm sorry but I was very disappointed with my first visit at Mojo Coffee House located on Magazine St in New Orleans. I ordered a size small coffee (shown in the picture) was was personally a small portion for a size small. I paid almost $8 for this coffee and it didn't taste good at all. I took many 4 sips and didn't finish the rest. It just had a nasty spoiled taste. I think it could've been the almond milk... I have no idea but I don't recommend. Maybe try whole milk and it will taste better ‍ Also, I was super excited to try the mermaid smoothie bowl but they didn't have any of the ingredients to make the bowl so I was also very upset about that ): 1 star rating... won't be going back.

This Panera location always seems busy and a bit out of order. The dining area tables are wobbly and are typically occupied by teens and tutors. The staff seems to get along well as they have personal conversations and giggles as they work to fulfill the orders. Glad to see them smiling rather than drudge through their day. This location could earn more stars if they repaired things and swept up a bit more often. The location has a steady flow of customers which might account for the messy floors and tables. The food is consistently good and fairly priced.

My family and I were in the area looking for something good and fast. Thankfully, yelp directed us to this place. Upon entering, we were greeted by friendly staff, who stood by very patiently as we were deciding what to grab. My kids were won over by the 90's nostalgic games and candy/toy machines...We ordered the steakhouse burger, classic cheeseburger, mac n cheese, fries w/cheese sauce, baked beans, and a banana shake...The burgers were very delicious, the bacon was cooked to perfection, and the sides were awesome. The only thing I'd do differently is ask for no salt on the fries, they were a tad salty, but still not a dealbreaker...The banana milkshake was the best I'd ever had ommmggg! We'd definitely visit if in the area again. Reminds me of a high quality Steak N Shake
Magazine location doing an awesome job keeping their customers safe and Happy with great food!  Thank you!

ordered a garden salad only iceburg lettuce with cucumbers and tomatoes with creamy italian dressing... the salad is clearly not iceburg lettuce only the cucumbers are spongey and disgusting and obviously the dressing is not creamy italian.. in order to fix this the manager said i need to come back and bring it to him... this isnt the first order they have messed up
Love this establishment, food is great and fresh atmosphere is great as well. This is a must have

We had a reservation and then waited an hour past our reservation time before getting seated! Unbelievable! The food was decent but the BLT was served with sun dried tomatoes even though the menu said regular tomatoes. So gross.
Fresh sushi. Reasonably priced. Excellent service. They are currently open for take out. Call ahead and order is ready within a reasonable time.
The food was awesome!!! Got the seasonal pumpkin cheesecake and was very satisfied at the recommendation of Momma Dawn. She really knows her stuff!! Super friendly with my doggo too!
Seems like it is ok to not wear masks in the kitchen with visitors! Don't go here! That's wrong during Covid times!

Always love the Cheesecake Factory. From Danbury to Mt Laurel and here in Syracuse. I never miss one when I can go.
Go to meals for us include chicken belliago and my signature lemon drop. Crispy Brussels sprouts, fried Mac and cheese, fish and chips and flat bread pizza are a few of our sure things when we are there.
We do a bang up job on appetizers and the bread is a favorite of the table! My companions even know and recommend the Saturday night soup!
By dinners end we have take home portions for lunch and cheesecake slices to go and eat and home is how we round out the night.
Oreo, salted Carmel and mango key lime have  come home  with us more than once!
Next time pictures for sure.

What can I say about this hotel, well the bathroom was not clean the toilet was the worst part,  maintenance had to come in an adjust the temperature and he was rude,  bedding was definitely.. Front desk is not knowledgeable when it comes to the fees at all. definitely overpriced you can find much better than this one.
One of my favorite places to brunch! The phenomenal spread and bottomless mimosas are the perfect combo. Would eat here everyday if I could! 12/10!

Stopped in here after a long day at Busch Gardens and we were not disappointed.  It is located in a strip mall, but upon entering you are transported to a German beer hall, complete with large tables and benches and 2 bars.  The hostess was very friendly and gave us our choice of seats.  We ended up at the bar, but in hindsight it would have been a more authentic experience in the main dining room.  This location also has an extensive list of draft beers from Germany as well as other places and they brew some of their own beer in house as well.

We started with the pretzel and beer cheese.  It was very good, but nothing too spectacular.  I doubt if the pretzel is made in house.  The cheese dip was nice.  Following this I had to choose between schnitzel or sausage.  I ended up going with the sausage dinner which includes your choice of 2 types of sausage and 2 sides.  It also came with a delicious pretzel roll which I preferred to the pretzel appetizer.  The knackwurst was very good, but I wasn't super impressed by the bratwurst.  It could have used a few more spices for flavoring.  When eaten with some brown mustard though it was good.  For sides I went with the cheese and potato pierogie which was small but very good, and the whole pickle.  I expected an entire pickle, but instead received 4 pickle spears.  Still good, just not what was expected.  The meal with 2 sausages and 2 sides was entirely too much food.  If I get the sausage again I would get the order with only 1 sa

Stopped by on a whim.  I am from out of town and it sounded good on this cold rainy day.  The turkey alvacado on the Dakota bread was excellent but I was really let down by the barley soup.  Especially for the price it did not seem made in house at all.  It had the taste and consistency of a Campbell's can of ministeone with black beans added.  It's pretty suspect when the carrots and potatoes are perfectly cubed and then mushy from sitting in liquid for so long!  No worth the price!  People were friendly.  Service was fast.  Dinning area was quaint and clean.  I definitely enjoyed it while staying out of the rain!

To;dr - Unfortunately, I had the worst dining experience here. It's actually the worst dining experience I've ever had in my life. Not knowing what to do when food rolls off the plate into the table is not ok! Hair in the food is never acceptable at a "fine dining" establishment. 

------

We were promptly seated at a round table for 9. The server came to introduce himself and give us the drink menus. Dinner menus were provided at a later time. 

He went over the top choices and his recommendations. When we ordered, the food took a long time to come out because they like to serve everyone at the table all at once. 

As my fried chicken was being placed down in front of me. The top piece rolled off and he didn't now what to do! He spent the next 5 minutes chasing down the GM or the head server whole the chicken just sat on the table. The head server finally comes over and asks me if I want a new entree which will take 45 minutes (seems absurd for mediocre fried chicken) or if they can refry a new piece for me. I told them a new piece is fine. 

The GM came over to apologize but didn't offer to comp anything. 

Moments later, as my friend was digging into her lamb dish, she found a piece of hair. She thought it was just an anomaly and kept eating. Then I saw another piece of hair and we started to dig and found 2 more pieces of hair. A total of 4 pieces of hair in her dish. Just unacceptable. They did end up comping her entree. 

Pork chop was disgusting. The flavors were sligh

I will say 2 things about this place: fancy and delicious! 

I went before the pandemic and it was good, their menu tend to change so take this into consideration. The hamburger is GREAT and on point, very tasty. Also, they have a good variety of brunch options. 

The service was really great, I'm planning to go back soon so I can check social distancing and try the desserts, because it looks sooo good on instagram.

I loved the desserts at this place. Not only were they super cute, they were also delicious. My husband got some sort of pistachio mousse. It was the best thing I've ever had. Not over powering with sweetness. I also ordered a matcha cappuccino. I couldn't finish it because it was too sweet. Maybe ask for no sugar. I didn't realized I needed to say that.

Decided to return after a few weeks and was happy we did ! We love Cricketers there food is excellent and large dishes. Kristen our waitress was great and a real hoot, we will be back. Sometimes you find a restaurant you just feel at home in....this is one of them !

My husband and I came to this location for our anniversary, it was our first time eating here and Paige went above and beyond!!! Our experience was amazing she was so friendly everything she recommended on the menu was absolutely delicious. You can tell she really appreciates good tasting food, from the wine to the entree and desert everything was amazing! We will definitely be coming back! Paige thank you so much for the amazing experience!!!!

Yes yes yes yes yes !!!! This is how burgers are supposed to taste ! Absolutely delicious burgers, so much flavor, just wow. So far I've only ordered from here once but it will most definitely NOT be the last time. Looking forward to trying more items on their menu, I have no doubt they're as delicious. Highly recommend

We ordered the Easter family feast and had it delivered on Saturday at 5:00. The meal was delivered on time. The ham and turkey breast slices were very good as were the green beans, cherry pie, cranberry, dressing, rolls. I found the mashed potatoes and gravy excellent. The serving were ample for 4 people. We had left overs. I'd order it again for sure.

I ordered takeout for dinner. After trying the phone at least 6 times, i finally got through after calling Brick Wall Tavern, the affiliated bat attached to the restaurant. Got through to the host and learned that they do not do takeout orders on weekend evenings. Went in to order and wait for the food. Ordered a Duck Hunt and a Snawzeech for takeout. Duck hunt 7/10 and as ordered. Snawzeech was missing the cashew ricotta which was the whole reason i ordered the pie. 4/10. No cheese to cut the pepper. Essentially 1/3 of the toppings were missing. Very disappointed. 

Ordered the Snawzeech a while back at the Jersey City location and it was great. 9/10. 

Only saving grace was the mushroom Arancini. 9/10 even as takeout.

Our favourite restaurant in Edmonton. 
Get the pressed sushi roll or the omakase meal!
Fantastic food.

Updated review: I am changing it from 3 stars to 1 star. I thought I was ready to forgive them, we went and ordered 2 salads and they brought the dressing up to the register and I went to pay! I was so relieved, not realizing that once again they neglected the dressing. I mean is it really that hard to place it in the bag? It's every single time!!! Now we have to drive all the way back. I'm done with Chipotle. Never again.


Chipotle is really great. It is. Their guac is always on par and their food is consistent and is good every time. However, EVERY TIME I order a salad in a takeout or doordash or Ubereats order, they 100% of the time forget to put the salad dressing in the bag, which is literally the only reason I go to chipotle because I'm obsessed with the vinaigrette. If you're thinking of ordering a salad, and it's takeout, just make sure you emphasize the dressing and ask them to double check.

I hated to be a "Karen" because I usually only share my true opinion here on yelp and I'm not one to "send food back" kind of thing, but after the third time (which happened a few months ago in Utah), I called and they sent me on a wild goose chase through door dash, chipotle customer service (which, by the way, only exists in the form of you submitting an "experience" online) and I never heard back. I know it sounds ridiculous, but I had had a horrible day, hadn't eaten all day, and wanted that salad and that dressing and they forgot it... I was so upset. And they never ever c

What a terrible experience had at Texas de Brazil... we have been before and really enjoyed the value and experience, but this dine in experience was horrible to say the least. My boyfriend's family and I were out for his birthday dinner to his favorite restaurant. For starters the typical salad bar is unavailable due to covid-19 so you are supposed to fill out a check list asking for family style salads and sides. The waitress did not offer the checklist as we had to request it. Next, half of the items we requested did not make it to the table. Honestly, it should not cost $50 per person during covid with the half-effort salad bar offering and with multiple meats taken off the menu. On top of that our waitress was only around probably 3 times tops in our 1 hour and 45 minutes or more dinner so you can imagine how often our glasses were empty. Even the men walking around shaving meat seemed to be avoiding us while the tables all around us were clearly getting premium service. Then, a long blonde hair was pulled out of my mom's meat meanwhile not a person at the table has blonde hair. The manager did not have much to say other than that the men passing out meat have short hair and hair caps so it wasn't them. No attempts were made to make our experience any better and nothing was taken off of our bill. After receiving our bill we asked if the manager would be willing to compensate for our awful time and they offered a to go dessert, but refused to show the display of artificia

Yelp Reviewers.... get off your high horse! It's mac and cheese! And it's delicious! No need for social commentary on the well-being of the American youth. If you don't want to eat carbs and delicious, delicious fat topped with decadent accoutrements, then don't. And there's no need to tell the Yelp world about it. This is a systematic problem with this platform. You're not Sam Sifton and this isn't the New York Times! 

Props to these folks for giving the Treasure Valley a spot (that doesn't travel) to enjoy confort food at it's finest. The Spectrum isn't what it used to be but I'm coming here for some Mac regardless!

This review is based solely on the food. The service was definitely 5 stars. Now I've never had a Chicago style hotdog until today, so maybe it's just not my thing. In my opinion it was just ok, nothing worth going back for. The green relish had a hint of sweetness to it, so I could appreciate the balance with the mustard, onion and peppers. I purchased the mag mile polish sausage. I was expecting the sausage to be plumper, but it was kind of your standard hotdog size. Also, with all of the toppings the flavor of the sausage gets lost. The bread, however, was pretty tasty; I liked the texture. Come on now, Chicago, this was a little over rated. Maybe the pizza will redeem my Chicago taste buds because this was just not it for me.

The Ruby Slipper Cafe was quickly recommended for breakfast by the front desk staff at Harrah's. It was a short five minute walk. It was still early and we were seated right away. Our server suggested The Peacemaker, which is your choice of any two of their Benedicts. We chose the Eggs Cochon and the Corned Beef Bennie. 
The food came quickly and piping hot and it didn't take long to make them disappear. So yeah, the food is great. The service was quick, helpful, and attentive. True Southern hospitality and an easy five star rating.

This restaurant was recommended by friends. We don't get out much anymore, especially since Covid. The service was good. The food ----not so much. Now let me say that I know times are challenging, and I appreciate efforts and I understand there are cut backs. We ordered the charcuterie board which was plentiful and loved the variety of bites--especially the smokey, pickled green tomatoes! That was my first bite--devine!!! The cheese variety was exceptional! So I ordered the beef bourguignon and my husband, the steak au poivre. It was an interpretation of the dishes which I wished that was explained. My dish had a red wine gel-yep gel--that was cold. It said there was a foam which was absent. and braised beef shank--which I never found. One bite of the cold gel was a completely unexpected and a turn off. My meal stopped dead in its tracks.
My husband ordered the steak au poivre with duchess potatoes. If you have never had it--it's a steak with coarse black pepper ( a lot of it!) and a Cognac cream sauce and was served with duchess potatoes which  are normally creamy, buttery, whipped potatoes that are browned on the peaks. If you have had the delight, you would have been disappointed with what was presented. My hubby gave me a bite which was adorned with a bone marrow, super garlicky butter, sans cream, sans pepper, and the faintest wisp of Cognac. The Duchess Potatoes were considerably over browned, and if tapped with a fork--the sound reminded me of crisp pavlova. It simply
The sushi here is so good!! I love sushi and this place seems to be the best place in town for any sushi lover like myself!

Chick-Fil-A ... you know what you're getting already. The wonder of waffle fries and strips or sandwiches for lunch or supper or perhaps their minis or biscuits for breakfast, either way it is good stuff. I love this chain.
       This location really has their stuff together, with two lanes and people waiting with iPads to take your order, everything runs smoothly. They are efficient and polite. Above all, even through a sea of customers ( some of whom are perhaps a bit cranky) this group is genuinely happy to serve... and not in that smarmy way that a used car salesmen is. When they say "It's my pleasure." They mean it. 
      This is hard - especially dealing with some of the everyday customers that you get in the restaurant business. This location is to be applauded for their service and goodwill to others. You are the best!

Great food, great service everything you can ask for from a restaurant! Loved it! The amount and wuality of food you get for the price is incredible. Restaurant is BYOB don't forget. Look forward to many more dinners here!!

Horrible service and average food. I was recommended to this place by a employee at our hotel. I am vegan and my husband is full carnivore, but obliged for me. We looked online at the menu prior to deciding on this restaurant. Upon finally receiving our menus after ordering drinks ( because none were available at seating ... approx 20 minutes later) it was not the menu online. 
We ordered our drinks which the wine came out fairly quickly but my chai took the 20 minutes ( came about when the menu arrived) and upon arrival the waitress forgot to bring honey and a cup. Our actual waitress didn't return to our table to take our order or so we could ask for a cup for about another 5 minutes. 
We finally ordered the linguini and tacos and as a appetizer the Brussel sprouts. The Brussel sprouts came out fairly quickly and were flavorful. The linguini was cooked extremely well and quite good. The issue was with the tacos and service. 
I had a slight allergic reaction to the tacos. The waitress showed absolutely no concern and didn't come back to our table for another 25 minutes. We had finished and were waiting to leave for almost 30+ minutes for our check. 
I could understand if the restaurant was extremely busy, but that was not the case. I love supporting any vegetarian or vegan restaurants, especially privately operated. Being a small establishment you have to set the bar higher, I don't feel that was done on this experience.

We found this place on yelp and went for the first time. Let me tell you that this place did not disappoint! Friendly staff and owner. Made us feel like family. The food was exceptional. We like eating at Zoes Kitchen but this place is so much better!

This is my second time at a Shake Shack franchise. This time I ordered a Shack Burger with medium fries. The wait was not long, with the line moving along efficiently. I was given a device that would vibrate once my order was ready. There were patio space and few tables downstairs but upstairs, where I ended up, had a good window view as well as plenty of tables to sit. The burger itself was good - well cooked and wasn't soggy. The quantity of the fries were a bit more than I anticipated but taste-wise, it was pretty good - crispy and not too salty. 

I recommend coming here for not only the burgers but to hang out - definitely more than enough space to chill as you eat.

Great food great service 
Homemade sauces are wonderful 
Chips and salsa are always fresh

This is a great place to pick up items you might not find at your local grocery store. I come here to get things for homemade sushi and other Japanese dishes. The store is small so there isn't a lot of selection but it's very clean and easy to get around. Prices are fair as well. The sushi they serve also looks good.
Dinner was a joke! Chicken burnt and cold and chewy as was the rest of my order and some items even missing!

We wanted something different - Takeout Hibachi and Sushi? Yes and it was excellent!!

They have a little window setup for to-go orders during the pandemic. We are eating takeout but still not dine-in so this was perfect. 

Quality of the food was excellent. I have picky eaters in my house and they all loved it. 

If you want something different from your usual takeout try it!

People rave about the Cuban here - I just say, I'd give it top 3 for me. 
If you're really hungry, it's the perfect portion. If you aren't super hungry, you can definitely save half the sandwich for a mewl later. 
The bread is perfectly crispy and not too thick. The meat is all flavorful and blends well, with the sauces and pickles acting like icing on a cake. The only thing I might request next time is a few more pickles. 
Decent amount of seating. Other items on the menu looked yummy (pastries and salads). 
Also, a separate coffee bar. 
Friendly service.

I came to the Vinoy for a spa appointment and had time between appointments for lunch and decided to eat at the hotel restaurant. I was pleasantly surprised by the food! I didn't want to eat anything heavy so I went with a lobster caprese and it was amazing! I never thought of having caprese with burrata and it will definitely be something I try at home now. You get a good amount of lobster too, which is good because this salad is pricey, but worth it. Service was great and fast. They had great mimosas also!

This location is the worst and not deserving of the Panera name. My last 2 drive-thru experiences: 1) a half hour wait with only 1 car in front of me and 2) nobody even showing up to take my order. You would be better off going 15 minutes out of the way to the West Chester Panera - you might even save time.
So good! The sushi at this place is some of the best I've had. If you want good sushi go to Sushi Cafe

THE FOOD WAS AMAZING! Service was very fast and food was hot. We had the battered shrimp taco platter and the battered fish taco platter and really enjoyed ourselves. Definitely good food and a great price. Service was very friendly.
Bowl with orange chicken and chowmein, hard and dry! How can the food not be fresh right at the lunch hour? Most of it went in the trash.

So yummy! And the service was great! Keirsten was amazing! So friendly and gave us great suggestions. We had the Tvravs and saganaki for apps. Then I had the Chicken parm with Alfredo pasta as the side for dinner. It all came out super quick and was really flavorful. Try the baklava for desert as well! Will definitely be coming back!!

We had a wonderful experience at Tony's on a recent visit to Indianapolis.  The service was top notch - our server was friendly but not overly so, always available without hovering.  Cocktails were great and the wine list was extensive.  We also really enjoyed the bread, which came with regular butter and a sweetened bourbon butter.  I'm not normally one for sweetened butter but this wasn't overly sweet and was really great on the excellent crusty bread.

They were very accommodating in allowing us to split a bone-in ribeye cooked to two different temperatures - we would not have been at all surprised or offended to have been told no to that request, but it was no problem.  The steak was absolutely delicious.  We chose mashed potatoes and Brussels sprouts as our sides.  The potatoes were fine, about what you'd expect at a steakhouse.  We did not care for the brussels sprouts at all - I think they were finished with balsamic vinegar, which is fine but they were really doused in it, so not great.  We left most of those. Dessert was creme brûlée, which came in a nice portion for sharing, but wasn't huge.

Overall the steak was great, the rest of the food was solid, and the service was outstanding.  We will definitely be back on our next trip to Indy.

I called in to do take out the other day. I did their three roll combo for $20. I think you can order any roll as I got some dinner and some lunch rolls. It was ready on time, the way they packaged it was fantastic compared to some other places I've been. It was clean when I walked in with everyone spread out with masks on. The rolls were delicious and I was happy with all of my choices - fresh fish, good portions, well plated. I'm sure the parking lot can be hectic as it's right next to the Dutch Bro's but I'll definitely be back!

Went to try this place out. It was clean and modern with lots of baseball decor. The sushi rolls we got was crunchy roll, spider, dragon, and tiger roll. The tempura veggie and shrimp were good, fresh light batter and fresh veggies. I would come again next time. Got really full here

I ordered a Cali Bowl from SoFresh on Howard for the first time today for lunch.  Although I was extremely disappointed  with the delivery from Grubhub, as it was 40 minutes late, I loved the food.  I just wish I could have taken my time to eating it so I could enjoy it more, but I didn't receive it until the end of my lunch hour so I had to rush eating it.  The food itself was very flavorful, fresh and a generous portion.  I will definitely be ordering it again for lunch, but I will have to find another way to have it delivered or I will go pick it up myself (I work 1.2 miles from there).

It was so good that me and my friend went there 2 days in a row for 3 days trip. Avocado toast is easy to be plain but it was amazing here. If you ask for adding salmon, it will be a LOT of salmon added on top. Dessert at the front of the restaurant were really good too. They weren't overwhelmingly sweet.  Service was really good and fast.
This place was horrible and service was even worst. The place, was a hole in the wall!

I think their food is fresher than other places and taste pretty good. They cook everything well and have a really clean restaurant. Take out can be a hassle though, but I think it's worth the wait personally.

The food was great but the wait was a little long. I had to speak with three different people to make sure we would be seated. The waiter was nice enough and the atmosphere was nice and the place was well-lit and quaint.

We stopped in for the first time for dinner and a beer and was very pleased. The atmosphere, food and craft beer was well above average and we plan to return soon and often. Our server was brand new and was very attentive and added to the experience.
We got this pizza delivered to yardarm. Amazing! Best pizza in Boise we have had so far!

I am leaving this review solely based on the service. I ordered a head and my order was ready, they were just waiting on fries. I have done this before and it takes 1 minute usually for them to get the fries and put it in the bag. I waited 20 minutes before I saw fries go up the pass, and then they sat there for another 10. I was about to say something when another person came to pick up their order. The staff informed her the order was ready and that they just needed to put the fries in her bag. They then proceed to give her the fries on the pass that I had been waiting for! I had to interject at this point ask the employee why she got the fries that I had been waiting for 30 minutes. The employee didn't have an answer and just said "oh". I almost cried because I felt the staff had forgotten I was there but I was standing at the counter waiting the entire time. This location needs more employees for dinner rush, because they give or so working there clearly could not handle it. I'm sorry to say this. Very disappointing.

My experience was horrible, i like my steak well done, had to send me steak 4 times to the kitchen cause was bloody inside and on the last time the brought my steak back still was pink inside, over an hour waiting for my food for that and my friend already finished his food and me back and forth with a dang steak getting burned outside and still pink inside, server was great, soda and breads were good, manager was like meh idc
We had the best time in this bar. It is clean and comfortable, the food is delicious. Out bartenders were attentive and our drinks were never empty. Best bloody mary's in town.
Great sushi for take out during this time at reasonable prices! Party trays are very filling and delicious.

I am so happy I found this place!! Cauliflower crust!!!! It's ACTUALLY DELICIOUS TOO!!!!! Let me tell you this is a new huge breakthrough and game changer. Absolutely delicious and I got the "tour," which is such a perfect match to the crust.

I don't live anywhere near a Steak 'n Shake, so any time I am near one, I have to get a shake. This trip might have killed that for any future visits. As for their COVID adjustments, no complaints. The person at the window had on a mask, face shield and gloves and they held the card reader out of the window so she never touched the card. The shakes on the other hand were a flop. We ordered 4 shakes and only the person that got the vanilla shake was satisfied. The people that ordered the orange freeze, m&m shake and the chocolate shake all said theirs had funny tastes; one person saying that it tasted like dirty water was used in it or something wasn't properly cleaned. The person with the m&m shake complained that it was not thick as expected (very soupy) and there were hardly any m&ms (they were actually concerned that it was the vanilla that they grabbed because they initially couldn't find any). Also the whipped cream on top seemed to separate in a strange, clumpy looking way, though it tasted fine. To top it off, no receipt was offered so no rewards points were able to be claimed.

Nice economical breakfast for takeout during the Coronavirus pandemic. One of a few times I've had chicken for breakfast other than fried chicken and waffles. I like it! Personnel wore masks to protect employees and customers for takeout orders. Contactless payment was preferred. Very efficient service. The Chick does it Quick.

Honestly I just went there for the first time yesterday (in covid times) but it was so good i had to review it. Got the korean fried chicken sandwich and it slayyyeed. It had a little kick which totally added to the sandwich without being overwhelming. The fries are better than most, definitely get them with a sandwich - you'll be glad you did. And they have so much dessert which was a pleasant surprise so grab a donut, cookie or something else from there too. The girls working there seemed pleasant & kind (in out on the phone & brief pick up interactions) which is always a plus. Def go there!! support local

A small place you might easily miss but good thing you didn't. This is going to be the next hot spot for a BYOB dinner. Beyond the exceptional service, the food is amazing. Honey from the chef's personal bees, and usage of local ingredients.. worth every penny! This is the place to go to try new things. The cheese board was so so good. We also ordered the duck and rabbit as our main course and it was more than enough food for 4 people. Highly recommend!
PUBES???? Estas en serio?? This is beyond unacceptable. Esto es como hacen negocio? De da asco por pedir comida de ustedes.
Expensive, ended up paying $21 for 3 drinks. He charged me for almond milk in the mango tea however there was no almond milk in it! I feel ripped off... never going back.

Awesome food and service!
Will definitely be back.
Very impressive that the management takes the time to address the bad reviews posted here .
Our experience was great .

Best fish tacos that I have ever had in philadelphia. Everything is super fresh! The workers are all very sweet and welcoming . Comfortable,clean, calm atmosphere. One of my go-to's. Great for sit down  or take out and to come in and do work on your laptop.
Nice selection of ready to take home cakes. Lil pricey but tasty. I've had an Italian rum and German chocolate. 10" $30 They are easily 5 pounds. I'll keep trying different ones, carrot next

My husband and I stopped in for dinner as they were having an early dinner special. We didn't partake, but they also had half off wine bottles on Wednesday. The prices were awesome! For $13.95, you get bread rolls, a salad, an an entree. We also got the fish spread as an appetizer. My husband enjoyed the salmon entree and I loved the coconut almond shrimp entree. I know some people may not like this, but I like the fact that the portions for dinner aren't gigantic. I do think the prices for bottled/canned beer was a little steep (e.g., $7 for a can of Reef Donkey), but I couldn't help but give it 5 stars for the awesome service, food, and other pricing. We woll definitely return!

The food is amazing! I recommend the burger or club sandwiches as they are my faves. My husband loves their pulled pork sandwich.  I'm convinced that all items are good, despite I haven't tried all - yet!

Located in such a cute little shop, I found this place through a casual yelp search. We ordered the following: 

1) James Brown Po Boy: Roast beef, gulf shrimp, pepper jack cheese, & dressed. This was so good and it was stacked! They offer their po boys in two sizes: 5 1/2 & 10.

2) Cup of Jambalaya: Also delicious. The jambalaya was smoked and consisted of chicken and sausage. Really flavorful. 

3) Bread Pudding: Omg this bread pudding was so moist! I loved that it came with the icing on the side so you can adjust it to your liking. 

I would definitely come back here for my Po-Boy needs!

Absolutely amazing. From the unique dishes to the attentive staff!  The  Pappardelle (homemade) di Granchio was to die for especially followed up with their tiramisu and creme brûlée. Truly a dining experience, already can't wait to come back and show more friends/family this gem! And it's a BYOB :) - picture is of the Artichoke Burrata app special.

I'm so sad... I love Bluewater Grill but we did takeout tonight and it was a BIG mistake!
My husband ordered fish and chips with fries and seasonal veggies for his sides. I wrote in the order " crispy fries " ketchup and malt vinegar. 

I ordered Cioppino no salmon or not a lot of salmon. 

When I went to pick up the order I wanted them to confirm it was all correct and thank goodness I did because they gave coleslaw instead of veggies and did not have ketchup or vinegar in the bag either.  They added all that and I left. 

We got back to our hotel and I was super excited to eat and we unpacked the food. My husband opens his container to find cocktail sauce spilt all over his SOGGY fries!

I opened my bowl of cioppino to find a piece of soaking wet garlic bread on top. In the cioppino it was 4 mussels, 3 clams and 10 pieces of mini shrimps. Then the rest salmon. No crab or calamari like the picture shows on their menu. 
I ate the shellfish my husband ate two pieces of the fish and we tossed the rest away. We just ate leftover pizza from today's lunch. Super bummed we just wasted $55
Alot of variety and the drinks were tasty! Fast service and short wait to sit down. Beautiful view

I've had the bahn mi, tater tots, and fried rice and nothing has disappointed. Every time my friends and I go to bars downtown we always end the night talking about their tater tots because they're unreal. The aioli that comes with them is a 10/10.

The Hot Pastrami should be called the REDEMPTION PASTRAMI!!!This was my second time going to Lucky Dill. Last time I got the three sandwich sampler and was disappointed. This time Hot Pastrami on sesame challah rolls with fries was the way to go. I liked it because the meat was hot and melted in my mouth the way my pastrami in NYC did. The sandwich was big enough to split with one side as suggested by our server. The cauliflower bites were delicious as well. The atmosphere was really hip with New York themed signage and plenty of plasmas screens with different games on.

This is the worst location to order from. They always get things wrong. Leave items out or over cook the food. Have ordered from them through delivery services and we are always having to complain about the food. Ordered from them today. Got a kids meal and they forgot the fries. The fries that literally come with the meal. And on top of that the chicken was over cooked on both the kids meal and the regular boneless meal we got.
The boxes are almost always covered in sauces and soggy. They forget sauces. When you order a medium chicken is more like a small. Horrible all around.

Ordered two Korean BBQ Cheesesteaks with garlic Parmesan fries on the side a week ago and they were delicious! Left philly last week but haven't been able to stop thinking about that meal. Highly recommend!

I think this is the cleanest diner I've ever had the pleasure of eating at. On top of that it has the most friendly staff. The food is right in line with there restaurant. I've had the omelet, egg breakfast and a few of there lunch items. Don't miss out on this one.

The service here is top notch and it's just a fast food spot. The manager works hard and is obvious when you see them going around assisting on all aspects of the job. Saw some kids have a milkshake fight while it was packed and he calmly cleaned it up after escorting them out. I would have freaked but he was very professional. Now to the food the crispy bacon the tender chicken, the fresh salads. I have to say for fast food it's worth it. Only reason this doesn't have 5 stars is the parking lot is too small and parking on many occasions isn't worth going to. If the habit app was set up for this location that would help out

This place is amazing got tandoori chicken 
Masala fish cooked to perfection 5 star dinning without the five star pricing u great service thank u so much this is my new spot from now on
Poor customer service, did not have anything in stock that I wanted and what was substituted for my order was dry and tasteless.  Would not recommend sadly.

I went through the drive through today and they had bad customer service. Also forgetting the ranch like they always do. Plus the person on register forgot to give us our change and then when we waited she came up to the window and asked "what do you want?". They also didn't give us a receipt. Just bad experience in general.

I love their soup!! Especially the lasagna soup. So delish! Also, the service has always been exceptional and I've never had to wait more than 2-3 minutes to be helped. I love coming here on my lunch breaks.

After driving around looking for food and many places being closed due to inclement weather, we landed at Panda Express. Thank you for being open for our take out Tuesday. Came in about 8pm and there was no line no wait, some pros after a winter storm right? 
Needing to feed enough for 4, we got the family feast. Priced at 29.99$ it includes 2 large sides and 3 large entrees. We ordered double fried rice, double orange chicken, and honey sesame chicken. 
My fav is the orange chicken. The flavor is just wonderful. The honey sesame chicken was decent. The fried rice isn't the best I've had but it goes well with the chicken. 
Fast service is provided as food is already put in warmers. Workers greeted us as we entered. During covid, there is no dining. Take out and delivery is offered. I feel with no dining service, it makes the store appear cleaner. Parking spots are available in front of the spot, so convenient and easy access. 
Having picky eaters in the house and not wanting to cook, Panda Express was acceptable. Thank you to the workers that roughed it out through the snowy weather and came to serve the community. Our house appreciates it!

Huge bistro serving breakfast, then lunch/dinner. Employees were pleasant. Very clean.

I can't help it. I ordered what I always do, the Swedish meatball meal. As always, it was delicious. The desserts are always great as well. Calories mean nothing here, since you will walk it all off anyways, right?

This particular IKEA restaurant is located on the second floor and is in the corner of the building so has plenty of places to sit and relax, especially for families. Huge bathrooms are located behind the bistro.

I overheard a naysayer griping about the view of the parking lot. Obviously they must not have been able to look up a few inches to see the lovely view of the Tampa skyline. We actually liked sitting there, eating our meal with that view.

Remember to bus your tray!
This chicken y'all!!! Amazing... hot, crispy and just the right amount of spicy. Service was fast and friendly. We will definitely be back!

Cheap Chinese food. What can one expect! Absolute favorite is chicken lo mein and the fried rice. Their soups are really good as well. The sizes are plenty to Last for two meals easily.
Not a fan of the Mongolian beef because they add an entire large onion and maybe four tiny pieces of actual beef into it. Also stay away from the sweat and sour and garlic chicken. Iffy. Again all In all its cheap Chinese food which is pretty decent.

My friend and I went for our pre concert get together. We ordered a pitcher of mimosas, which was delicious and lemon drop shots, which were made just right. 
I had the bread sticks of the month which was the Cordon Bleu and they hit my stomach just right. 
Our server was very friendly and attentive despite there being a full house. 
I would definitely go back again.
If I could give it a 0 I would. I got food poisoning from their food from last night. Please don't eat at this place!!!!!

Visiting New Orleans in business. Looked up Recommendations on Yelp and this was #2 in our area. Got there at 7 pm and place was pretty much empty, which concerned us a little. Very authentic, old bar with only about 10 tables. Small and nothing fancy. My exact words were "Well, Yelp hasn't disappointed me yet, so let's try it."  Place is really clean and quaint. 

Friend and I sat at the old school bar and had a couple of drinks (FYI no draft beer but lots of choices in bottle).  We ordered the Creole white bean and shrimp. I had the bread pudding too. Both were fantastic. 

Yelp did not disappoint. Place was great and food was great and by the time we left, place was packed. Thank you Micah the bartender for being friendly and serving us. It was delicious.

We placed a rather large order for curbside pickup. It was expensive. The chicken wings were pretty good. The three pizzas were just average, fairly flavorless; frozen Organic pizzas from Sprouts are so much better.  The calamari was terrible--way over done and more breading than calamari. We threw it out after tasting it.  One of the servers we saw was wearing a face shield without a face mask beneath it. CDC does not recommend the use of face shields as a substitute for masks. We will never go back or order from this restaurant.
Tacos are good! Service could use some work ! But I would go back! Went on a Monday not alot of people there at lunch time which I was surprised!!!

What a gem of a place! Service was top notch and food was excellent. Myself and a friend ordered the following to share: escargot, French onion soup, foie gras, and chicken in red wine. Everything was prepared perfectly.

Downhill?!  I hadn't been to Pint in a while and showed up with my family because it was the shortest wait of all the options.  Well there was a reason.  Service was extremely slow, in a negligent way.  

Food was average but you are dropping a premium price per plate.

If you are going for more than drinks, I'd say consider your options.  Going to be a bit before I'm back...

This is a great little spot in Clearwater Beach, rich delicious coffee and tasty baked goods. My wife was happy they had gluten free options, and the owner is super friendly... be sure to come check it out!

This place is great, happy hour is amazing. I ordered incorrectly and they fixed it and brought us free cake for the trouble! The staff is friendly and the atmosphere is pleasant. It's close to the harbor and funk zone. I was recommended here by the crew aboard the Double Dolphin sunset cruise - they were not wrong - also highly recommended!
Sarah was our rockstar server, definitely recommended coming here!

I wish so badly this was as close to my house as it was my hotel. Also wish I would've came here daily fo breakfast to my stupidity i saved this for last meal before the flight.  We arrived around 8-8:30am already quite a few people already sitting. Quickly sat and greeted. Mimosas and specialty coffees all looked amazing! Fiancé ordered hazelnut latte, absolutely so smooth and not a watered down latte. I chose the eggs cochon, and oh my goodness. I have never in my life had homemade biscuits well really any biscuits taste this delicious. Soft where it's supposed to be with the right amount of butter and toasted ness on the tops.  This meal was definitely a heavy breakfast but well worth it.  The pork was so tender and with the hollandaise sauce and biscuit this is a dream breakfast. Our waitress and everyone here is so friendly and awesome!! Will be back when I'm close! Ill have biscuits dancing in my dreams till them.

Food = Outstanding.
Staff = Outstanding and so friendly.
Why only 4 Stars? = Way too loud with music and kitchen staff banging pots and pans, and one member of the kitchen staff that wore his COVID face mask below his nose and kept taking his face mask off.

Called in to order for the first time and service was great! Our dinner plans changed last minute and El Limon made the night awesome. Our order was ready for pickup within 15 minutes. Tried the tacos and tostadas and will come in for more soon!

I mean its basic and sweet and quaint and smeels like cheese steak
The guys are friendly and they have a following
When the weather is nice theres tables out front
It hit the spot
This location offers a large patio area for safe dining during this COVID period. We enjoyed our evening dining experience here and recommend it highly!

The food was good, the live music was nice and our waiter was friendly ! I gave this place 4 stars because the hostess who sat us yesterday was unbelievably rude. We are visiting from San Diego, California and we were a party of 11 and we almost walked out just because of how rude she was. Our party had to sit at separate tables, which was expected because of covid and that was completely fine. But we told her when we were seated that half of our party was parking and was right behind us. When they walked in, she made them stand in line to be seated although there was an empty table right next to us. She was argumentative and when she finally sat the rest of our party, she walks up and says, "are you guys sitting there or not?" Because we were trying to figure out who was sitting at what table. My party wanted to walk out and eat somewhere else, but our waiter was friendly so we stayed. I can't imagine how many customers this place loses because their first interaction is with her.

Very good! Outside seating...staff super great - they wear masks...all was great but the Eggs Florentine was SO good- chock full of spinach, ever so tasty! Fantastic hash browns - everyone enjoyed their breakfast....thanks!!
We stopped he Thursday evening.  Food was good, service too.  We'll come back next time we're in town

I've been to this location several times before. It's always clean and bright. The staff are always kind and very knowledgeable about the food options. Whenever I'm being conscious about my eating (which should be more often than it is) I find myself here! The choices are very flavorful and season-themed. My favorite is their salmon Mediterranean bowl. Very delicious! This time I made my own bowl and added all the vegan options, including, the tofu scramble. Yum, yum, yum. The only thing my husband and I felt is that the brown rice was a taaaad under cooked and crunchy. Looking forward to coming back soon.

I ordered a lunch special last Friday and the bill was $10.86 for the chicken chop Suey and the fried rice when I checked my checking account this morning after everything posted from the weekend they added a $30 tip on to my bill and there was no tip that was even left the total bill should've been $10.86 I think that that's very wrong to add a tip onto someone's bill without their permission or without them even adding it on themselves so you lost a customer. Plus this was a pickup order. Shame on you Sky Dragon. That is theft and I did report it to my bank!

The husband and I had a nice anniversary dinner here last night. They were able to accommodate us at 5:30pm outside even though we just called to make reservations three hours before. The outdoor area is super cute. It almost feels like I'm dining in someone's fancy backyard. The tables were well distanced even more spread out than CDC regulations require.

The service from our server couldn't have been more friendly. Since it was Saturday, the menu was prix fixed, three courses for $45/pp. we split the Mediterranean Sampler. While it was all good, the roasted veggie dip was our favorite thing on the plate. My husband ordered the Cavatelli & Lamb. It was so good and the lamb was braised well and still very moist. I got the Seafood Paella. The presentation was the best because it came in a tagine pot. The taste was good but I felt like the seafood could have been fresher.

We got the hazelnut gelato for dessert and also received a complementary berry sorbet that they just made fresh. Both were delicious! I would recommend Byrsa for the service and the ambiance.

I swear the brownie is the Cody's slide is frozen. They are flavorless and never good!! Yuck. What else here is frozen and not fresh . The chicken in the chicken fried chicken is  fatty and not a good piece of chicken. 
The service at this place is always poor. Hostess is unfriendly and ordering take out is a pain. You can't order from her, you have to wait a few minutes for the takeout person to become available. 
Definitely a huge meeting place for people aged 60 and over. 
If you get takeout, always check your bag before you leave! There's a good chance it's wrong or missing something.

Had my first canes! Super moist chicken fingers with a nice lil crunch coating. Cane sauce is blah but honey mustard sauce is better. Coleslaw was pretty basic for coleslaw and the fries were in need of some more fry. The Texas toast was not Texas toast at all. It's tasty but it reminds me of one of those square hot dog buns you use for a Sonoran dog. It's doughy.

nice views and decent food I had fun walking down the bay 
nice staff member named chris e

Stopped in here on a recent Saturday evening with the lady - a tired party of two. This was a perfect spot, and a great place to end the day with a full belly. We sat outside in front, ate vegetarian items, and didn't order drinks (but the complimentary chai after was a pleasant surprise). The overall vibe is informal/relaxed, with subtle but attentive service.

Pros: delicious food, friendly service, quick service even though it was only one guy up front apparently doing everything, low-key and funky decor, great spot to sit and watch the world go by.

Super-pros: curry fries - a big plate of home food that you don't regret having eaten, lovely chai tea (first time I have had one I actually liked).

Cons: still thinking...
Still trying to recover from the food I ordered. Catfish and fries. Catfish wasn't completely done and fries were old and cold.

Poor quality and pricey. The experience was uncomfortable, the restaurant was really hot inside, maybe the AC was out, there were a couple of fans placed throughout. We got the pad spicy noodles and it was heavily drenched in a sauce that tasted overly sweet. Seafood hotpot was full of vegetables like onions and bell peppers that didn't really seem to belong and low quality shrimp/scallops. Shrimp fried rice was dry. Overall, would not be returning.

We were looking for some fish tacos to replace what we knew in San Diego, Fish Shop. 
OH MY, OH My

This place is awesome, awesome.
San Diego has problem. 
The Baos and Rock fish tacos are absolutely amazing
The Crunchy Tataki is exquisite...
The Poke avocado is mesmerizing...
Tongue was dancing like crazy with spices and sauces. 

We Found our Place!

Service phenomenal!

I wish i could give this place a zero stars worst customer service EVER!!!! The Muslim lady in the front was good but the owner and his wife are horrible.. they wouldn't refund my money for food that my child didn't like she didn't even eat . I work hard for my money to be wasting on food that my child didn't Even like or eat... they are rude and the owner even showed a gun like he was going to shoot at my and my children.

Jazz-drinks-food: in that order.

They have regular entertainment and all of it is worth coming out for. Good wine selection, bartenders make good drinks, and the food is decent.

We had the seared scallops app, not bad. We also had the fillet and gnocchi which were pretty good as well. The food isn't amazing by any means, but it's good considering there's jazz and good drinks. Check the music schedule. 

We really liked "The Sermon!" They play one a month, 2nd Friday of the month. They are SOLID.

Enjoyed the taste of their Pizza, had them deliver a medium pizza at $16 one week and called for another one a week later and ordered a large at $23or so and they delivered me a medium size. Will never use them again!
